test_title: PYST 12: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends, A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are seating around a square table, facing towards the centre. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides of the table. One seat is left vacant. D is sitting exactly at the centre of one of the sides of the table. C is sitting at a corner, third to the left of B. There are exactly two people sitting between C and D. F is an immediate neighbour of both B and D. A is second to the right of F. E is not an immediate neighbour of A, but third to the left of F. G is an immediate neighbour of C. Where is the vacant seat?

options.text: Third to the right of C
To the immediate left of B
To the immediate left of E
Third to the right of D

solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: D is sitting exactly at the center of one of the sides of the table. There are exactly two people sitting between C and D. C is sitting at a corner, third to the left of B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b505402a6dd7c13ac373b5972b820aadad9a555588362f32b02098a747944fc4.png] We place D at center then place C leaving two places such that C is to the third left of B.

Step 2: F is an immediate neighbour of both B and D. A is second to the right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/256c536b37393c8989163945387f876e0fdc699ed111d27fa51998df4adb34e9.png] Now we place F immediate right of D and place A second right of F.

Step 3: E is not an immediate neighbour of A, but third to the left of F. G is an immediate neighbour of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/153b6d569325beeda13a239d0914f7fe0d799985d706fa5984f63d7b3ec48156.png] At last, we place E third left of F and then we place G immediate next to C.

From the diagram, we can see that **the vacant seat is on the immediate left of B.**

Hence the correct answer is **option 2)**
